notes: window_start/window_end is only the randomised START window for the main pass. There is deliberately no end-of-queue cutoff: if the main pass runs long, the remaining accounts still run, in order.
gap_min/max_seconds is the randomised cooldown BETWEEN accounts in a pass (minutes, not hub's 2-5 seconds).
retry_gap_* is the gap between the end of the main pass and the start of the retry pass, later the same morning.
Reset times differ by realm (domestic vs international) and are NOT encoded here yet: confirm both realms' reset moments from a few days of task-status timestamps before fixing window_start.
Accounts themselves are NOT listed here. In production they come from hub's AccountPool; this file never holds credentials.
